user.title: Find your address
user.description: Enter at least 3 characters of your street address, for example “Storgatan 1”. Up to 10 matches are shown, so be specific.

select.title: Select your address
select.description: Address missing? Cancel and search again with a longer text.

reconfigure.title: Change address
reconfigure.description: Enter at least 3 characters of the new street address.

error.no_results: No addresses found. Check the spelling.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach NVOA. Try again later.
error.no_services: No active waste services were found for this address.

data_description.advance_days: The “Pickup soon” sensor turns on this many days before a pickup and stays on until the end of the pickup day. 1 = from the start of the day before.
